RESULT [curation]: At 32M samples seen, the top-10% pool (by CLIP score or T-MARS) is best. At 640M samples the top-30% pool is best. US [curation]: This speaks directly to 'small high-precision base, then small increments trained over and over'. A small, strictly filtered base that is retrained for many epochs every round will stop giving utility, and the loop will then need looser, larger increments.
